blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of the Visayas (UV) marked its return to home-court action in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) with a hard-fought 76-69 victory over the University of Southern Philippines Foundation (USPF) Panthers. With that, the Green Lancers opened its second-round campaign in Season 26 on Sunday, October 18, at the UV Main Campus Gymnasium. According to Cesafi deputy commissioner Danny Duran, it was UV’s first home game in the league since the 2010-2013 seasons, when Cesafi held home-and-away games.
